author: Rowmen
body: (Sorry for my bad english, im spanish). Hello, im Rowmen (my nick) and i get temporarily banned on 28 of june by Jiveh for "Aim assist (admitted in Screenshare)". I was talking with him in the TS when he banned me and he say's that in a few months me would be disbanned. I've learned the lesson. Please disband me.
